additional_info.subject: RE: ID0378340-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP / RD 170003000] 'PT1000_BT3_Automation' changed to true - (VIN:0 CRE:0 CSM:0 SCE:0 SRI:0 ORI:0 OHW:1 OHS:1 OHSe:1 ST:T) CRM:00579001074
additional_info.body:
Hello Magnus,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked for the past 3 days and found error
'PT1000_BT3_Automation' toggling. But currently there is no error flag.
We suspect that this error flag might have raised because of one or more of the following issues:
Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust.
The temperature is hot and is making the temperature raise a lot inside the charger.
Sensors not measuring/working correctly.
Issue with Fan rotation.
Therefore, we need to inspect a few things onsite.
Hence,
need to check the following things onsite-
Check if filters are clear. Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust.
Check if the Fan is rotating properly?
Check whether Sensors measuring/working correctly or not.
Also need to check the electrical connections of FAN and sensors. Refer the KA below for checking further connections:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled - Dynamics 365
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_BT5_MainFanGQ1_XD9.2B - Dynamics 365
Check the connections - terminal blocks, connectors and loose wirings as per the diagram below (For BT3). Because sometimes faulty connectors or loose connections also causes the issue.
Kindly check BT3, resistance values should be according to the temperature values. You can refer the chart below for the same:
If BT3 found to be healthy then only we need to check for KF6 module as per the diagram above.
But according to our observations, we suspect BT3 to be faulty. Because, Following we observed in the logs:
Hence, need to check the same onsite.
Kindly carry spare BT3 sensor while being onsite.
If found faulty, need to replace it.
Please share your observations once the above mentioned items have been checked.
We will wait for your feedback.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
